Ticket details / Linear
FAC-41 · Backlog
Separate saved links by user
Depends on FAC-40
Source note: “Auth → separate links per users”.
Ensure each authenticated user can access only their own saved links.
Suggested completion criteria:
• Scope link reads and mutations to the authenticated owner.
• Verify isolation with two accounts, including direct requests for another user's links.
• Decide how existing local links acquire ownership before migration; preserve existing data.
• Check associated content, tags, and processing results for cross-user leakage.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-42 · Backlog
Improve browser extension integration with Linklog
Blocks FAC-43
Source note: “Better Browser extension → Better integration with rest of software”.
Review the extension-to-app experience and define the integration gaps to address before release.
Suggested completion criteria:
• Record the concrete gaps before implementation.
• Verify connection, reconnection, and the main browser-to-library workflow end to end.
• Make disconnected and failed-operation states understandable and recoverable.
The handwritten note does not specify the integration defects; this ticket starts with that review.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-43 · Backlog
Prepare and publish the extension to the Chrome Web Store
Depends on FAC-42
Source note: “Better Browser extension → publish to google store”. Interpreted as the Chrome Web Store.
Prepare the release package, listing, required assets, and applicable permissions/privacy disclosures; complete the store submission and track review through publication.
Suggested completion criteria:
• Verify the packaged extension against the intended released Linklog environment.
• Complete listing and release materials.
• Track submission/review status and record the published listing URL when available.
Store account details and production origin are not specified in the notes.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-45 · Backlog
Improve the bulk actions UI
Source note: “Bulk actions → improve ui”.
Improve how users select items, see the selection, and invoke available bulk actions.
Suggested completion criteria:
• Make selection and selected-item count clear.
• Expose available bulk actions with understandable enabled/disabled states.
• Show operation progress and partial-failure results without losing track of the selection.
Bulk delete and bulk open are tracked separately.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-46 · Backlog
Add bulk delete for selected links
Source note: “Bulk actions → Bulk Delete”.
Allow users to delete selected saved links in one action.
Suggested completion criteria:
• Delete only the selected links the user is authorized to modify.
• Clearly communicate the number of affected items before deletion and provide a confirmation or recovery mechanism.
• Update the list and selection after completion; report partial failures accurately.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-47 · Backlog
Add bulk open when Browser is enabled
Source note: “Bulk actions → Bulk open if Browser enabled”.
Allow users to open selected saved links together when the Browser integration is enabled and usable.
Suggested completion criteria:
• Open the selected links through the Browser integration.
• Gate the action on Browser availability, with an understandable unavailable state.
• Report failed opens accurately.
Confirm exact tab/window behavior during implementation.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-40 · Backlog
Choose and implement authentication (Better Auth or Cloudflare options)
Blocks FAC-41
Source note: “Auth → Better Auth or Cloudflare options”.
Choose an authentication approach compatible with Linklog, then implement the sign-in, sign-out, and session flow.
Suggested completion criteria:
• Document the choice between Better Auth and relevant Cloudflare options, including deployment constraints.
• Verify sign-in, sign-out, session persistence, and unauthenticated access behavior.
• Keep per-user data isolation tracked separately.
Provider choice remains open; the notes do not select one.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-44 · Backlog
Define and implement the upload endpoint
Source note: “upload endpoint”.
An upload endpoint is requested, but its intended payload and behavior are unspecified.
Clarification needed:
• What is uploaded: a file, link list, extracted content, or something else?
• Which client calls it, and where should the uploaded data appear?
• What formats, size limits, and duplicate behavior are expected?
Suggested completion criteria after clarification:
• Document the request/response contract.
• Implement validation, clear error responses, and appropriate user ownership.
• Verify one successful upload and representative invalid requests.
Do not treat the examples above as selected scope.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.
FAC-48 · Backlog
Investigate and fix the “Needs attention” bug
Source note: “needs attention bug”.
A bug is reported in the Needs attention experience; reproduction steps and expected/actual behavior were not included.
Clarification needed:
• What action triggers the problem?
• What happens, and what should happen instead?
• Does it affect a particular link, processing state, or filter?
Suggested completion criteria:
• Capture a reproducible example and expected behavior.
• Fix the identified cause and verify the original failure case.
This ticket records the report; the bug has not been reproduced or diagnosed.
Source: Notes_260927_225751.PDF, page 1, Pre release. Completion criteria are an organizational draft derived from the note, not additional confirmed requirements.

FAC-40 · Backlog
Research and approve authentication, then implement
Choose authentication through an explicit research → owner confirmation → implementation sequence.
Plan:
1. Compare Better Auth and relevant Cloudflare options against Linklog's deployment and session needs.

2. Explain how the account model can support future payment plans; coordinate with <issue id="b867c23e-3877-4b80-8878-53c581cd3435" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-49/research-payment-providers-and-cost-based-plans-paddle-creem">FAC-49</issue>. Billing implementation is outside this ticket.
3. Present the recommendation and ask the owner to confirm the approach before implementation.

4. Implement sign-in, sign-out, and sessions only after confirmation. Per-user isolation remains <issue id="7b2520e5-32a7-47b2-a116-3fe68e58f625" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-41/separate-saved-links-by-user">FAC-41</issue>.
Acceptance criteria:
* Document the options, tradeoffs, and approved choice.
* Verify sign-in, sign-out, session persistence, and unauthenticated access.
* Define a stable account identity suitable for future plan entitlements.

* Preserve the dependency <issue id="c371b882-58dc-4e65-9390-05128e6be23f" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-40/choose-and-implement-authentication-better-auth-or-cloudflare-options">FAC-40</issue> → <issue id="7b2520e5-32a7-47b2-a116-3fe68e58f625" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-41/separate-saved-links-by-user">FAC-41</issue>.
No authentication provider has been selected.

Source: handwritten feedback on Linklog Pre-release.tldraw, reviewed 27 September 2026; original Notes_260927_225751.PDF. Acceptance criteria below operationalize the feedback; provider choices and unspecified policies remain open.
FAC-44 · Backlog
Implement a secure URL-only upload API with plan-aware limits
Accept link URLs only; this is not a file-upload endpoint. Secure requests and associate each submitted link with its owner.
Scope:
* Define URL submission, validation, ownership, duplicate handling, and clear error responses.
* Evaluate optional metadata/content delivery in the response or via webhooks; choose and document the supported contract before implementation.

* Resolve eligible plans, rate limits, and usage limits through <issue id="b867c23e-3877-4b80-8878-53c581cd3435" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-49/research-payment-providers-and-cost-based-plans-paddle-creem">FAC-49</issue>; numeric limits are not decided.
Acceptance criteria:
* Valid authorized submissions produce the expected saved-link/processing result; invalid or unauthorized requests are rejected.
* Document request/response fields and any asynchronous delivery behavior.
* If webhooks are selected, define authentication, retry, and duplicate-delivery behavior.
* Enforce approved entitlements and limits, with clear responses when exceeded.
* Verify successful submission, invalid URLs, duplicate submissions, and limit handling.
Open decisions: submitting clients/authentication mechanism, response vs. webhook delivery, eligible plans and exact limits.

Source: handwritten feedback on Linklog Pre-release.tldraw, reviewed 27 September 2026; original Notes_260927_225751.PDF. Acceptance criteria below operationalize the feedback; provider choices and unspecified policies remain open.
FAC-45 · Backlog
Redesign the existing bulk-action UI to support more actions
Bulk actions already exist, but the current UI does not comfortably support many options, and more actions are planned.
Plan:

1. Inspect the existing interaction and inventory current and planned actions, including delete (<issue id="81098730-a3b6-48f1-b73a-97b5281c90fb" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-46/add-bulk-delete-for-selected-links">FAC-46</issue>) and open (<issue id="6c360d7e-d64b-4e59-b3f1-e1c6245eda5b" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-47/add-bulk-open-when-browser-is-enabled">FAC-47</issue>).
2. Research good UI examples and present suitable alternatives with their tradeoffs.
3. Let the owner choose the interaction before implementation.
4. Implement the chosen interaction as a reusable component and a consistent UI standard.
Acceptance criteria:
* Preserve existing actions and selection behavior.
* Accommodate additional actions without crowding or hiding essential choices.
* Make selection/count, action availability, progress, and partial failures clear.
* Document the chosen pattern and how future bulk actions use the component.
This is an improvement to existing functionality, not a new bulk-selection system.

Source: handwritten feedback on Linklog Pre-release.tldraw, reviewed 27 September 2026; original Notes_260927_225751.PDF. Acceptance criteria below operationalize the feedback; provider choices and unspecified policies remain open.
FAC-46 · Backlog
Bulk-delete links and clean up associated content, records, and tag associations
Delete selected links together with their associated content, records, and tag associations. The handwritten clarification explicitly expands deletion beyond the link row.
Acceptance criteria:
* Define the owned records/content affected by deletion and verify that cleanup leaves no orphaned data.
* Delete only selected links and their owned data; preserve unrelated links and other users' data.
* Remove deleted links' tag associations. Do not infer that shared tag definitions should be deleted: decide the policy for unused/shared tags explicitly.
* Communicate the deletion scope and affected count, with confirmation or recovery.
* Update lists/counts and report partial failures accurately.
* Verify that in-flight processing cannot recreate deleted content or records.
Open decision: whether unreferenced tag definitions are retained or removed. The note says “records and tags” but does not define shared-tag deletion semantics.

Source: handwritten feedback on Linklog Pre-release.tldraw, reviewed 27 September 2026; original Notes_260927_225751.PDF. Acceptance criteria below operationalize the feedback; provider choices and unspecified policies remain open.
FAC-48 · Backlog
Fix inconsistent “Needs attention” tagging and improve retry recovery
Reported behavior: the Needs attention tag is inconsistent. Some links receive it repeatedly; others receive it and later recover. Investigate when and why it is applied, retained, or cleared.
Investigation:
* Trace affected links through extraction/processing, failures, retries, and recovery.
* Distinguish transient/retryable failures from cases requiring user action.
* Check for stale status, repeated processing, and conflicting transitions; these are hypotheses, not confirmed causes.
Acceptance criteria:
* Capture representative repeated-tagging and later-recovery examples.
* Define when Needs attention is added and cleared; successful recovery must not leave a stale warning.
* Implement a more robust retry/recovery workflow with bounded retries and visible failure reasons, based on findings.
* Verify transient failure → retry → success and persistent failure paths, including reload/reprocessing.
The symptoms are now specified; exact reproduction data and the root cause remain to be established.

Source: handwritten feedback on Linklog Pre-release.tldraw, reviewed 27 September 2026; original Notes_260927_225751.PDF. Acceptance criteria below operationalize the feedback; provider choices and unspecified policies remain open.
FAC-49 · Backlog
Research payment providers and cost-based plans (Paddle / Creem)
Investigate whether Linklog should offer paid plans. Compare Paddle and Creem, and propose plans based on Jev processing, content extraction, and storage costs.
Deliverables:
* Compare provider integration, costs, constraints, and fit using current official sources.
* Model costs for representative usage; separate measured costs from assumptions.

* Propose plan entitlements, usage allowances, and rate limits, including which plans can use the URL upload endpoint (<issue id="2b3edb20-2031-4b8d-b1d7-f09b14404f36" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-44/define-and-implement-the-upload-endpoint">FAC-44</issue>).

* Explain how accounts/authentication (<issue id="c371b882-58dc-4e65-9390-05128e6be23f" href="https://linear.app/facundopri/issue/FAC-40/choose-and-implement-authentication-better-auth-or-cloudflare-options">FAC-40</issue>) map to future subscriptions and entitlements.
* Present options and a recommendation for the owner's decision before implementation.
This is research and product planning, not approval to implement billing or choose prices. Whether paid plans belong in the initial release remains open.
